description: Lists the tenant's budget plans with id (the plan_id that get_budget_vs_actual takes), name, year, version, status and type, optionally filtered by year and status.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

status.description: Filter by status. Omit for all.

year.description: Filter by year (e.g. 2025). Omit for all years.

name: list_budget_plans
